product.name: Commission
product.lede: Commission is the Rust SDK and runtime model for governed autonomous workers. It binds a reusable agent revision to a durable case, under a governor that decides what the agent may do next. The executor proposes; it never marks a case complete.
product.meta: Rust · specified in ESS · domain-neutral · Apache-2.0

art.caption: Generated from ess/ by commission-docs. The Rust model comes from the same source.

sections.title: Responsibility, not just an agent.
sections.lede: An agent is configuration. What you hand over is a case, and what carries responsibility for it is a commission.

items.title: Agent and revision
items.description: Reusable worker configuration. A commission names one agent revision, not the agent in general.

items.title: Case and commission
items.description: A case is durable work under a protocol; the governor holds its truth. A commission binds one agent revision to one case, with a principal and an authority context.

items.title: Run
items.description: One bounded period of execution. A run records the case revision it started against, so a proposal made on another revision is stale.

items.title: Governor and frontier
items.description: The governor returns a frontier: what is known and unknown, which obligations are open, which actions are admissible and which need authority. Completion is its determination alone.

items.title: AgentExecutor
items.description: Proposes an action from the frontier. Loom is the native executor; harnesses, workflows, people and test fakes implement the same contract.

items.title: Effect invocation
items.description: The runtime, not the executor, invokes an action's effect, after rechecking frontier, case revision and authority. Decided in Atlas ADR 0082; not built.

sections.title: Propose, recheck, then act.
sections.lede: A selection made on stale state is not permission. The local runtime loop runs the first four steps in this order today; the last step is decided design, not shipped code.

steps.label: Govern
steps.title: Frontier
steps.description: The governor issues a frontier for the current case revision.

steps.label: Propose
steps.title: Executor
steps.description: The executor picks an action the frontier lists. Nothing else it says is trusted.

steps.label: Recheck
steps.title: Revalidate
steps.description: Stale if the case revision moved; refused if the current frontier no longer admits it.

steps.label: Authorize
steps.title: Authority at the call
steps.description: Allow, deny or approval required. A provider that fails never allows.

steps.label: Act
steps.title: Invoke, once
steps.description: Decided design (ADR 0082): the runtime invokes the effect. Not built.
